response.justification: Strong fullstack profile with well over the required 6+ years, including recent hands-on TypeScript/Node.js product work, React, MongoDB and AWS at Optilyz, plus current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience at re:cinq that directly maps to the 'AI agent development' requirement. Deep testing culture (TDD, CI/CD, authored test runners and assertion libraries, taught Selenium/testing courses) and polyglot breadth fit the 'multiple programming languages' and quality-focused expectations. Main gaps are stack-specific rather than fundamental: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest or Kotlin experience, and React appears in only one role. Given the depth of adjacent experience these are likely quick ramp-ups, so an interview is warranted with probing on frontend depth and the primary framework stack.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack; recent TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS delivery
Direct AI-agent/MCP tooling and developer-framework experience
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship record (TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling, teaching)
concerns: No stated Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Kotlin experience
Frontend work skews Ember.js/legacy; React exposure appears limited to one role
Relational DB (PostgreSQL) depth unclear; much niche DLang specialization

key_factors.factor: Missing core stack specifics (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
